description: Exact value of a continued fraction [a0; a1, a2, ...]. Later terms are at least 1. [3; 7, 15, 1] and [3; 7, 16] are both 355/113. The canonical field is the short Euclidean form. Returns JSON with: fraction, numerator, denominator, decimal, terms, canonical. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cf-value
